english: That'd be Laranthir. I suppose we should send some help.
That'll help.
That'll hurt their plans. Nice! Oh, I'd better get back into character... Ahem. Now, I must abscond! Watch out for Ziff!
That's Kormir! She blessed me at birth, but I never thought I'd—hail to you, Goddess of Truth. We need your help.
That's Zojja's private lab, though I'm sure you already know that. Zojja may be in there now, but she doesn't always like visitors.
That's a bit more realistic.
That's a clever little trick.
That's a problem.
That's a question for the water haulers, Rupek and Porgar. It's their job to keep the troughs filled.
That's a sore spot we'll get back to in a second. Where is Mai Trin?
That's amazing! Good luck with your research.
That's an understatement! I keep telling them not to play around my shop, but they won't listen.I've lost count of how many times they've trashed my goods with their horseplay.
That's awful. Do you have any goods I can look at now?
That's because we take care of our own.
That's disgusting. I have to go.
That's enough fighting for me today! Double-time it to Nageling! Move!
That's enough questions.
That's enough sunbathing for now.
That's enough, both of you! Keep your head in the fight!
That's enough. Good-bye.
That's exactly what I'm thinking. We wait until the apple's ripe, then swoop in and take the tech.
That's fine. I'll leave you be.
That's good enough.
That's good news. Public embalming is so embarrassing!
That's good to hear. And I suppose she has Scruffy to keep her safe too.
That's good to hear. I couldn't help but notice you speaking with the queen earlier. How is she?
That's good! The teacher will love it! Praise you. And Joko.
That's good, at least.
That's great!
That's great! How do you like this assignment?
That's hard. Have you talked about this?
That's impressive.
That's impressive. Well done!
That's incredibly kind of you.
That's interesting, but I've got to go.
That's interesting. Thanks for telling me.
That's it! We've done it. Step through the teleporter, and we'll finally be in the Ascension Chamber.
That's it, they're calming down. It's going to be okay, sweet little decapods, don't you worry!
That's it. Breathe in the spores, let them work on you.
That's it. Use the whip. Keep 'em on task.
That's just it! WHY am I going to die? Tell me!
That's my last translation for today. I'm going to check the stew on offer; toast bowls with me?
That's nice. But it doesn't really make me feel better.
That's no ordinary beast...
That's none of your business. Back off!
That's not as easy as it sounds.
That's not really my concern. I'm leaving.
That's not what I had in mind, but it's a good idea. I'll check over here.
That's not where the centurion said they should go.
That's obnoxious. Good-bye.
That's okay. It must be hard to gather your thoughts after all you've been through.
That's ridiculous.
That's right! Dominion may strike, but we'll knock 'em right back!
That's right! Good job! Now for the last question. Who was Logan's best friend in Destiny's Edge?
That's right! Next question, and this one's also about names. What was the name of her mentor?
That's right, get of out of here you cowards! And this time stay out!
That's right. Could you return what you've taken?
That's right. I didn't even think of them. I really should have, too. Thanks for the warning.
That's right. I'm a merchant by day, but I'm a champ in the Bane.
That's right. Spotted some ancient-looking golden structures, and...well, you know us Priory folk and old, shiny things.
That's right. Taimi and Scruffy. Pleased to meet you, Mr. Important Zephyrite. I would love a chance to inspect—
That's simply not possible. You Seraph are the real heroes.
That's still terrible. I'm leaving.
That's technically true, but don't each of them focus on a different specialty?
That's the Pact officer we were warned about. Rally to me!
That's the first thing you've said that makes any sense.
That's the spirit! I hope you survive to come back and share tales of your exploits over a beer. If you're lucky, I'll tell you what it's like to be the greatest keg brawl player in Hoelbrak!
That's the spirit, Forgal. Now let's end this.
That's the spirit. I look forward to it.
That's the stuff! Once I get enough, I'll brew up a batch of oil.
That's too bad. I better go.
That's tough, but it's not like you woke up a dragon. You'll be okay.
That's true, I do. Good-bye!
That's true. Hey, I have another question.
That's understandable. I hope you find peace here.
That's what I thought.
That's what I'm here for.
That's what makes it so dangerous to us. And why we have keep tabs on each other.
That's what soldiers do. Braham's more than that. He's my friend, and I won't let him lose any more than he has.
That's what this place needed. Cannons at every choke point!
That's what we're here for.
That's what you deserve.
That's why I'm here. The dragon's corruption must be stopped.
That's why we need an army of our own. And I met someone in the Domain of the Lost who told me where I could borrow one.
That's your plan? You're going to barter and bribe your way to freedom?
That's... No... That's unthinkable. They wouldn't do that. Would they?
That's...not possible...
That's...not wise. You shouldn't be alone out here. Not now, not like this.
That's— Oh! It just moved! Did you see that? What am I saying. Of course you didn't.
That, traveler, is the command center of the Vigil. Only those who are in our order may enter.
That...hurt! (angry yell)
Thats right! Send that creature back to Mordremoth!
That—looks—extremely—painful.
Thaumadirectional polarity: reversed! The gate works both ways again. Mr. Sparkles, to me!
The "big guy" is Tizlak of the Nuhoch tribe. Ibli and I are a team. Our tribes are allies. And I have excellent hearing.
The **DATA MISSING** were a race native to the Maguuma Jungle. They mysteriously vanished decades ago.
The **DATA MISSING** were a seafaring people prior to their sea being turned to jade.
The Aeronotics golem has been modifed to consume lightning energy. Gives me shivers.
The Aidan Journal
The All Seer is shielding this chain.
The All Seer, keeper of the seneschals... Another example of the doyen's desperation.
The Ancient Forgeman becomes vulnerable to attacks.
The Aqualimit krewe has set up camp across the water to the north. They've had several clashes with the krait, and I suspect something is wrong. Could you check it out for me?
The Arcane Eye is the Arcane Council's private security force. They are charged with carrying out the council's orders, enforcing council edicts, and ensuring the safety of the councillors.
The Ash Horizon is bombarding Vigil forces on the beach. Fort Cadence is under Vigil control.
The Aspects are forces of nature that shape our world. We commune with Sun, Wind, and Lightning, and in exchange we receive great knowledge and power.
The Astral Ward is escorting the bound jade construct through the Valley of Agony.
The Awakened fought bravely on our behalf. We owe them everything.
The Blade fought mursaat tyranny from the shadows until we found the allies needed to wage war and retake Kryta. We hunted down the mursaat that the Titans spared, killing all but one: Lazarus.
The Blood Legion are the front line guys. They're the soldiers who lead the charge into battle and go head-to-head with the enemy. Their motto is: "Overpower."
The Boatswain
The Boss Blitz has completed! After a brief intermission, preparations will begin for the next Blitz.
The Boss Blitz is on! Get out there and fight!
The Boss Blitz will begin shortly.
The Bramble, ma'am. That's what I call the thorn wall. I've been tracking its growth.
The Branded are attacking!
The Branded—they're coming!
The Bridge
The Burning Effigy ceremony was completed.
The Captain's Council is sponsoring a celebratory treasure hunt as part of the festival! Find all the loot you can!
The Captain's Council is sponsoring a number of treasure hunts to celebrate the themes of the festival. You know, unity, cooperation—that sort of thing.

The Cathedral of Verdance at the other end of Winterknell Isle was built to honor the human god Melandru, but Zhaitain's influence has corrupted the ancient structure. We must contain that corruption to aid the Pact's coming assault on the Promenade of the Gods.
The Claw Retreats in %str1%
The Claw in Keane hands...
The Claw of Jormag has been defeated. Collect your rewards before retreating.
The Claw of Jormag has been driven from the Citadel Spire. Allied forces are advancing on the canyon below to finish the fight. With the Claw's defeat, the Frost Citadel will be decommissioned.
The Claw of Jormag has destroyed allied cannons. Destroy the guardian elemental to advance.
The Consortium is aware of your condition as well as this artifact that the Priory has been fumbling with for years.
The Consortium is very well connected. We have a proposal for you. Give us the Shadowstone, and in exchange, we will cure your hallucinations in a safe and natural way.
The Council can't stop us, they can only punish us afterwards.
The Crossroads Haven is under assault! They need our help!
The Crystal Bloom has arrived to lend you aid.
The Cuatl have come to take our food. Stop them!
The Dazzling Lucia
The Deldrimor ruins are richly historical but under constant attack. Until we hold them, we can't send people in.
The Dominion barrier has been broken, making this unit temporarily vulnerable to attack.
The Dragonvoid awaits. Is your squad prepared?
The Dream has been troubled recently.

The Durmand Priory is searching for artifacts in the ruins of Ascalon City, but the human ghosts that roam the area stand in our way. We do what we can to stop them from attacking us, but it is only a matter of time before they reappear, and we are only so many.
The Durmand Priory relocated relics from the ruined keep in advance of the city's reconstruction in 1328 AE.
The Elder Dragons can corrupt just about anything they touch...or look at, or breathe on. Some, like the Sons of Svanir, choose to be corrupted.
The Elder Dragons will fall to our might, and Vlast is the key. Your faith will be rewarded. Your hesitation will be punished.
The Exalted said Aurene was Glint's second scion, but we didn't know what happened to the first.
The Exalted within can channel a shield to repel the Elder Dragon's offshoots, but it won't last.
The Eye kept me alive and used my guilt to try to break me down, force me to be the mursaat's puppet.
The Eye! It sees me. It sees into my mind, into my Dream. There's no escape.
The First Mate
The Flame Citadel has been secured, and Jormag's minions are retreating!
The Flame Legion blew up our shipment of supplies. Normally, I'd just request another order, but we can't wait. Any piece of scrap metal could still be useable, for the most part. Have you found any?
The Flame Legion is assaulting the mill. Go and clear it out! I don't need any assistance here.
The Flame Legion thinks they can take this camp? Over their dead bodies! I'll show them what happens to traitors!
The Font of Maguuma—and it's magic—runs once more, yet impure.
The Forged took everything! Can you help us retrieve some of what we've lost?
The Frost Citadel gate and hangar have been destroyed. Allied forces are now assaulting the Frost Legion conversion chamber.
The Frost Citadel gate has been destroyed. Allied forces are fighting their way through to the Frost Legion armory.
The Frost Citadel gate, hangar, and conversion chamber have been destroyed. Allied forces are now fighting to escape the citadel before it crumbles.

The Granite Front is a war zone between Flame and the rest of the legions. Those smokelickers want our territory. We want to put them in a shallow grave. Join us on the battlefield. We need all of the extra firepower we can get to snuff out the Flame.
The Great Dwarf's power is upon you all!
The Great Zinn was banished as an attempt to eliminate the competition. However, his story has a fortuitous ending as the sham of a trial motivated Zinn to found the city we reside in today.
The Grothmar Grand Tour will begin soon! Can I add your name to the roster of racers?
The Gunner
The Harathi overlord has fallen! Celebrate for now, but be cautious: the centaurs will not soon forget this.
The Honor of the Waves is our sanctuary ship. We sailed here, fleeing Jormag, but one of his champions damaged the ship beyond repair.
The Inner Keep opens in: %str1%
The Inquest device is being shielded by its forces.
The Inquest has been cleared out, and the skritt aren't in danger. That's something to be proud of.
The Inquest have many creatures in those cages down there. We must release them before they can be experimented on.

The Inquest have yet to find a countermeasure to my countermeasure. Once my device has neutralized the poison they stole, all they have left is slightly bitter, foul-smelling, harmless frog secretions.
The Iron Legion are the guys who work day in and day out at the forge. They're responsible for making all the weapons and war machines used by the legion armies. Their motto is: "Steel won't yield."
The Iron Mines of Moladune.
The Itzel have grown bold. Kill the commander and their courage dies, too!
The Jade Brotherhood thanks you for the donation!
The Jungle Dragon knows we're here. It's getting scared.
The Kodan Claw is moving to counterattack icebrood forces.
The Kryptis invasion has been thwarted, and the barrier has been stabilized.
The Kryptis lieutenant overwhelms the area in: %str1%
The Lasciate Gate has been destroyed, and the Pact are establishing a camp in Orr.
The Legend of Long-Ear Lexx
The Light of the Forge Masters blankets you in a comforting warmth. You may now face the All Seer.
The Lionguard and Vigil are evacuating innocents to Lion's Arch.

The Lionguard is supposed to keep the Lion Road safe for travelers and merchants, but Kraitbane Haven is stuck between the Slaver's Deeps krait and an increasing undead presence. It's like an endless battle here.
The Lionguard is the friend of those who support free and open trade. Our membership is open to any race or gender. so long as they are willing to impose the idea of free and open trade on others.
The Lionguard isn't sending out patrols?
The Master-at-Arms
The Memoirs of Justiciar Bauer. Some pages appear to be missing.
The Might Warband Report
The Ministry Archives, full of forms upon forms, stands ready to document and record the opening of the empire's borders.
The Ministry of Agriculture has been relocated to a more secure facility after their...specimens kept getting loose.
The Ministry of Purity.
The Ministry of Trade has started new investigations following a series of complaints about malfunctioning jade tech.
The Mistlock gathered a motley menagerie of everything cruel and lethal. I urge you to tread carefully.
The Mists are transforming you.
The Molten Alliance's weapons test is wearing you out.
The Molten Dominator will retreat in: %str1%
The Mordrem are in for a world of hurt!
The Mordrem are too plentiful for the few remaining Pact soldiers to engage them in direct combat. If this campaign has any hope of continuing, we need allies.
The Mordrem won't catch us by surprise now.
The Mouth of Torment is the gateway to the Realm of Torment. Forged forces emerge from the Mouth and the portals that periodically open at the Maws.
The Navigator
The Nightmare Court are traitors to everything we learned from the Dream.
The Nightmare Court's been causing trouble?
The Nuhoch don't call that Rata Novus. We only know it as a forbidden pit of despair.
The Olmakhan elders are meeting at the docks to strategize about stopping Zohaqan and his storm.
The Olmakhan once fled you, but now they see a change coming! A change in us! And now they save us! Fight with them!
The Order is your only family.
The Order keeps watch, so that no matter where Zhaitan's minions show up—we know about it.

The Orrian undead have cornered us, driven us from our homes, and killed so many of us. They've got us surrounded. We're losing hope.  The Vigil are helping, but our shores are still falling to corruption.  Please help.
The Orrians are an incessant threat, but we're doing what we can to drive them back.
The Ox Shrine has been cleansed.
The Pact are attacking the Temple of Grenth.
The Pact are formulating a plan to capture Vorgas Garrison from the Flame Legion.
The Pact are moving on to Death's Gaze Torch.
The Pact are moving to establish a camp at the tunnel mouth.
The Pact are moving to reestablish a camp on Noose Road.
The Pact are moving toward Meddler's Summit.
The Pact brought thumper turrets to attract and divert destroyers. Practically a mating call.
The Pact have been driven from Stygian Deeps. Armada Harbor is in jeopardy, as is the entire assault on Orr.
The Pact is attempting to secure Penitent Camp.
The Pact is securing Jofast's Camp.
The Pact must be sending help. They can't just leave us here.
The Pact! We will show them a Flame Legion refined by war—an ally to the end! Their artillery will push back the enemy!
The Priory installed this energy monitor, but the Inquest shut it down. Transferring energy from a working energy monitor nearby might get it going again.
The PvP Browser has deemed that custom arenas shall be sold for gold now instead of gems. Would you care to see them?
The Quaggan Games are beginning at Zuckermaloo. If you're free, you should head that way. If you'd rather stay here, quaggan could use some help.
The Quartermaster
The Rata Novus library seeks donations—dictations, holo-dissertations, and more. Help make this the smartest city in the world.
The Rift Hunters serve Isgarren, the other wizards, and the Astral Ward, but it's our honor to work alongside you, Commander. Do you have any questions I can answer about the Rift Hunters?
The Rift Hunters serve Isgarren, the other wizards, and the Astral Ward, but it's our honor to work alongside you, Wayfinder. Do you have any questions I can answer about the Rift Hunters?
The Risen are breathing down our necks. They'll be in the ruins any moment. Any foothold they gain brings us closer to darkness.
The Risen are pushing toward Fort Cadence's center. The Ash Horizon is bombarding Vigil forces on the beach.
The Risen are trying to retake Fort Cadence's center. The Ash Horizon is bombarding Vigil forces on the beach.
The Risen has taken the Vigil's beach camp and are pushing toward Fort Cadence's center.
The Risen has taken the Vigil's beach camp and are trying to retake Fort Cadence's center.
The Risen priest of Grenth has been defeated.
The Sailor
The Scions...are listening.

The Sentinels are a special group of soldiers sent to keep the Brand's infection from leaking westward, but that's not all we do. We're constantly plagued by skritt who steal our supplies and tools. There are never enough soldiers to keep it all under control.
The Sentinels are rallying troops in the Brand.
The Seraph are advancing on Trebuchet Bend! All appropriately trained personnel should join the fight!

The Seraph have a small outpost at Hidden Lake. The bandits know that if they take it out, they'll be able to knock the Seraph back on their heels. They've got a dozen or so recruits primed for a suicide run.
The Seraph is coordinating an evacuation.
The Seraph were moving airships, troops, and supplies here to clear the fort of bandits, but it'd already been abandoned. Something else scared them off first.
The Seraph will never back down.
The Serpentwind cave entrance is southeast of here, just up the hill. Go quickly.
The Shade is protecting Lonai.
The Sirens were once great sorcerers. Only a fraction of their magic remains.
The Sons of Svanir at Jormabakke Stead have a special interest in developing power through magical means. We have a covert agent keeping a close eye on their actions.
The Sons of Svanir have desecrated Jora's shrine! Ginna went to repair it, I know she could use your help.
The Sons of Svanir have desecrated Owl's lodge. They even hunt the sacred snow owls. They're young and foolish, but they're so strong. What can an old snowbird like me do against all of them?
The Sons of Svanir have quieted down. Now norn and grawl alike can rest for a while. Thank you.
The Storm Arrives in %str1%
The Sun god smiles on us all. Come, let us speak with the chief.
The Sun will rise again before I'm finished with you.
The Terranexic krewe imbues its golem with energy absorbed from beneath the very ground on which you're standing.
The Tyrian Alliance is using mounted siege weaponry to blast open the barriers shielding the organs.
The United Legions hold over half the territory around Jormag's tower. Tide's turning in our favor.
The Vigil are in need of assistance! Lend your support!
The Vigil calls! Join us, and fight beside Jhavi Jorasdottir herself.
The Vigil has claimed Fort Cadence. No action is needed at this time.
The Vigil stands ready. As senior officer, I'll observe as the crusader here beats your challenges.
The White Mantle was a religious cult formed years ago in Kryta by Saul D'Alessio, a drunk and a thief who preached the false doctrine of the Unseen Ones, his mysterious invisible masters.
The White Mantle will finally have the guidance it needs to carry it into a great and glorious future. Per your orders, we're shifting our focus to researching a means of weaponizing the bloodstones.
The White Mantle's protection came with a price. The White Mantle offered these ill-fated Krytan citizens they called "Chosen" as sacrificial victims to their demonic masters.
The Wizard's Tower's defenses have reactivated. Lyhr is resting in Droknar's Light, and Mabon has returned to activity throughout Skywatch Archipelago.
The Wizard's Tower...the sentinel watching over this town has vanished. No one has ever known the tower's purpose, but I compounded one lie with another, and I'm now paying for my hubris.
The Wolverine Shrine has been cleansed.
The Wolverine Spirit is stunned and is more vulnerable to damage.
The aftermath of an exploding god.
The air hangs cold and still. Partially-decayed bones are scattered across the ground.
The air here is too heavy! I can barely breathe.
The alchemists of Teku Nuhoch are exceptionally talented, but most don't like to travel far from our home—especially with the chak so riled up as of late!
The ale is getting to your head, friend.
The ancient monument remains silent.
The apples are shiny and red. They look magnificent.
The artifact will reach critical energy in: %str1%
The assault on the Lasciate Gate is on. Once the gate has been destroyed, the Pact will have established a foothold in Orr.
The author of this letter seems desperate.
The author of this letter seems determined.
The bait still glows and the fish don't know! Hoo, hoo!
The bandits and Inquest have been trying to forge an alliance, but now we are also seeing the Nightmare Court becoming involved.
The base's main reactor has been reactivated, feeding extra power to the base's facilities.
The basilica vaults are currently sealed. Speak with Isgarren to venture further.
The basilica's defenses are draining Isgarren's life-force.
The battle between humans and centaurs has gone on for generations. I only hope this little back door we found can tip the balance.
The battle is won, now rest. The war continues.
The bearer of this magic can activate Forgotten teleporters.
The beast could have easily ripped out our throats, but it instead deferred to the scholar who had assembled the armor.
The beasts are salivating, they can smell challengers on the wind. The scent of fresh meat.
The best bet is to sail yourself. Or maybe you could ride your Elder Dragon?
The best days are the productive ones.
The blessings of Melandru are already upon you. Travel under her protection.
The blooms are healing any damage we do. Take them out so we can finish this!
The bomb's down. Time for some fireworks!
The bonds of sisterhood extend beyond life and death. Rallies when downed if her twin is undefeated.
The book is scribbled in a code of squiggles and strange drawings—the ravings of a madman. Amidst the gibberish, the words "Eyes that Watch All' are written over and over.
The book was made with modern Krytan binding techniques. The title embossed on the spine reads: "Long Distance Relationships: 10 Ways to Make it Work."
The bookshelf contains a wide array of scrolls on the history of Palawa Joko, organized chronologically from "The Prepubescent Palawan Primer" to "Palawa Joko: Conqueror, Creator, King."
The bookshelf contains an array of geography scrolls, including "The United Kingdom of Elona: A Griffon's-Eye View" and "Joko's World: An Atlas of Awakened Authority."
The bookshelf contains an impressive selection of scrolls covering the details of necromancy and corpse preservation, such as "Reaping the Benefits of the Shroud" and "Specializing in the Spectral."
The bookshelf contains numerous scrolls, including popular titles like "Cocoa with Joko: Poems for Young Followers of Palawa," and "Lich, Please: A Vabbian Noble's Guide to Dignified Comportment."
The bookshelf holds a collection of scrolls on advanced combat training, including "Surprise: The Confessions of a Sucker Puncher" and "How to Bring a Knife to a Cannonade Fight...and Win!"
The braniacs next door are building another crazy contraption.
The broodmother will go to sleep in: %str1%
The bugs soak up magic. If we follow that magic, we follow the bugs.
The burden of the demon's realm oppresses you. Stacks intensity.
The camp to the south is our backup, but they haven't reported in. We need to check in there before we take the docks.
The camp's almost clear! Just a little bit more.
The canopy is quiet. Help the Pact gain and hold their foothold at the Jaka Itzel outpost.
The canopy is quiet. Help the Pact gain and hold their foothold at the Ordnance Corps outpost.
The captain and I go way back. We've fought through more enemies than you've probably ever seen. She's tough as nails, but cares about her troops.
The casino owner in Amnoon told me that the war god Balthazar rallies his troops at these camps.
The catalog contains list after list of books and documents, ranging from religious texts to history books to personal journals.
The cattle were actually a sign of relief for us. Our food storage had been depleted. The meat was delicious, and it reenergized us, but it started to rot pretty quick. We overtook them a week later.
The cauldron's intact. Back me up, Fero. This is going to be more complexicated that we thought!
The centaurs are trying to retake the earthworks. We still haven't received any reinforcements, so the Seraph there are sorely understaffed. Please hurry; they'll be quickly overrun without help.
The centaurs are trying to take the mine over. Please help us.
The centaurs led by **DATA CORRUPTED** are neither to be attacked nor experimented on. This tribe is friendly, and their home is an important refuge for krewes in the area.
The central organ is destroyed.
The chak aren't our only problem there. Look. That ley conduit blew up, probably closing the doors when it did.
The chak continue to prove resilient. Our surface-based defenses slowed their advances for a time, but it seems we underestimated the chak's ability to burrow.
The chak gerent has filled the tunnels with a toxic gas! Standing in the toxic gas will damage you over time, increasing damage as it stacks.
The chak gerents have awoken. Guards, fall back! We must defend Teku Nuhoch.
The chak would turn anyone into a recluse.
The chaos left in the wake of these attacks sets my research back a week.
The chest is locked.
The chest is sealed. A key is required to open it.
The choppers have a few bombs left. The primers should be intact.
The cinnamon raspberry tarts are so good. I could eat a hundred of them.
The citizens of Kryta have now rallied to our side. With their support, the strength of our steel, and the courage of our convictions, Kryta will have a queen once again. Long live Queen Salma!
The clods next door were up at dawn training again. Ugh.
The commander's role in our plan will likely be the toughest and most psychologically draining.
The condenser's fractured. Refractor's totally slagged. Unless a batch of new parts suddenly materializes...
The console glows brightly with the symbol of Ash Legion. It seems you can't put another key into it at this time.
The console glows brightly with the symbol of Blood Legion. It seems you can't put another key into it at this time.
The console powers up, allowing access to the door's controls.
The construct suffered a violent death. Its metal is tarnished, crushed, and torn. It's missing its faceplate.
The court's rulings seem fair and balanced.
The cover of the journal is faded and worn. Several pages are torn or faded beyond repair, but a few remain intact.
The crack where those fools drilled continues to expand at a rate of a quarter of a meter per day, despite the halting of further violation of the core stone itself.

The craftsmen are afraid. They were not prepared to be assaulted while we moved. Perhaps they thought the threat in the south was a passing madness from King Adelbern? Or did the king really know the horror that awaited us here?
The creature is being drawn to Agent Alloa's containment field.
The creature's movement will slow when this skill reaches 5 stacks.
The crew of the pirate ship Ravenous.
The crystal is unstable and susceptible to rupturing when held.
The current level of techno-magical waste exceeds recommended guidelines by: four thousand sixty-six percent.
The current year's precursor is created at the Mystic Forge using the 4 backpacks available from the League Vendor, which can be purchased with PvP League Tickets.
The damage is so widespread. We need to get repairs in place before King Joko returns.
The darkness has taken hold of you!
The debris is still warm which tells you that this vehicle crash-landed recently. It appears the survivors have left a note.
The demolisher has been weakened, preventing its boosters from firing.

The demon conjures axes that dance across the battlefield of their own volition. When another axe is created, existing axes retarget their original target. Deals increased damage to secondary targets.
The desert sun burns too strong, so I travel in shadow.
The destroyers killed my Kittaka! Rot and rust them all!
The device activates and hums an invigorating tune.
The devices aren't harmful to the druid husks. Their function is simply record data that's all. Our research is hindered while they're inactive.
The document is titled "Arcane Council Payment Checklist."
The door is sealed shut with stolen Raven magic.
The door won't budge until we find the missing pieces, and for all we know, there's dwarven treasure on the other side.
